title: Universal Properties of Petri Net Unfoldings
summary: It is an established idea in concurrency theory that every Petri net admits an unfolding semantics. This is a denotational object that represents its domain of possible executions. Unfoldings play an important role in practical analysis and verification. This paper is concerned with the following well-known problem: while the unfolding resembles a universal construction in the category of Petri nets, it generally fails to satisfy the expected universal property.
